content_fields.title: Verify that third party libraries use secure settings and the latest patches
content_fields.description: Pin dependencies to reviewed versions and run a vulnerability audit on every build.
content_fields.finding: Every dependency is declared with a caret range and no lower-bound security floor or audit step.

content_fields.required_fix:
# pyproject.toml — exact pins reviewed on a schedule
fastapi = "0.115.6"
uvicorn = {extras = ["standard"], version = "0.34.0"}
sqlalchemy = "2.0.36"
python-jose = "3.3.0"
passlib = "1.7.4"
requests = "2.32.3"

# .github/workflows/ci.yml
      - run: pip-audit --strict --require-hashes -r requirements.txt
criteria: Dependencies are pinned to exact versions in the lock file.
An audit step fails the build on a known vulnerable version.
Upgrades are reviewed rather than floating.
